title: EU withdrawal function
question: Does the store offer the withdrawal function, labelled with the official words or an unambiguous equivalent?
method: Read the link, button and image labels on the home page. Found when one carries the official label of Article 11a in any of the 24 EU languages ("withdraw from contract here", "Vertrag widerrufen", "renoncer au contrat ici", "desistir del contrato aquí" and the other 20). Review when a link names withdrawal in other words ("Widerruf", "withdrawal form", "rétractation"), which the law allows only when unambiguous. Not found otherwise. The second step ("confirm withdrawal") and the acknowledgement come after the link and cannot be checked.

spec.title: Directive (EU) 2023/2673, inserting Article 11a into the Consumer Rights Directive

title: Withdrawal and cancellation buttons (Argentina)
question: Does the home page show the botón de arrepentimiento, and the botón de baja where subscriptions are sold?
method: Found when the home page has a link or button containing "arrepentimiento" and, when the home page or a sampled product page offers a subscription (suscripción, billed monthly, a billingDuration in price markup and the like), one containing "baja". Review when the arrepentimiento link is there but the baja link is missing although a subscription is offered, or when only a baja link is there. Not found when neither is there. Runs only when the store appears to sell to Argentina.

spec.title: Argentina Disposición SSDCyLC 954/2025 (botón de arrepentimiento and botón de baja)

title: Statutory return period stated
question: Does the returns policy state at least the withdrawal period the store's markets grant?
method: Read the returns policy found in the home page links and any merchantReturnDays in the markup of the home page and the sampled product pages. On the policy page, take every number followed by a word for days, and use the longest period found. Compare it with the statutory period of each detected market: EU and UK 14 days, Argentina and Chile 10 days, Brazil 7 days, Colombia 5 business days. Found when the longest period meets every detected market's minimum. Not found when it is shorter than one market's minimum. Review when no period in days is found or no returns policy was found.

title: Subscription cancellation route published
question: When the store sells subscriptions, does it publish how to cancel online?
method: Runs when the home page or a sampled product page offers a subscription (auto-renew, billed monthly, subscribe and save, Abonnement, suscripción, or a billingDuration in price markup). Found when a home page link or button names cancellation (cancel subscription, manage subscription, Kündigung, Verträge hier kündigen, botón de baja). Review when only the terms mention cancellation, or when no cancellation route is found. Not applicable when no subscription offer is seen. Rules that are not in force yet are listed with the day they apply from.

spec.title: California Automatic Renewal Law, Bus. & Prof. Code §17602
